source.title: ION/MICRON PATCH DUMP SYSEX FORMAT
source.author: Bernard Escaillas (BEE)
source.note: Candidate until independently verified against Alesis Ion hardware/captures. The source contains at least one apparent oscillator-offset typo, so ambiguous fields are not silently guessed.

known_source_issues.issue: The 2008 table assigns offset 94 to both Osc2 shape and Osc3 shape, while the next row assigns offset 95 to Osc1 octave. AIM Editor will not guess Osc3 shape offset until independently verified.
The source's header table text orders Red/Blue/Green while its request section orders Red/Green/Blue. AIM Editor currently follows the explicit request-bank numeric list and marks it candidate.
Several source descriptions write raw {0,1} as {on,off}; polarity is retained as candidate raw-bit data until hardware verification.

The BEE text writes the bank-length formula with a 56-byte header, but its printed 46,154-byte normal-bank result corresponds to a 63-byte header (63 + 128*315 decoded bytes). Its printed 1,506-byte Edit-bank result instead corresponds to 56 + 4*315. Single-patch framing also proves a 63-byte pre-patch region. Bank-dump parsing therefore remains deliberately unimplemented until hardware or an independent dump resolves the contradiction.
